The '''Cerroban system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cerroban]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] lists the Cerroban system's region as the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], this conflicts with both its placement in the [[Bon'nyuw-Luq sector/Legends|Bon'nyuw-Luq sector]] and in grid square N-18, which fall in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Outer" />
